review.notes: All 60 full bilingual pairs and two player-gender variants read. Leave-alone wording and blockhead vocative corrected and reread. Native NPC proposal rejection paths confirm player-directed gender, with speaker gender independent. Repeated bouquet slash branches preserved. Stargdrop equals marker, line breaks, plus signs, F4 control name, ConcernedApe handle and exact original contact URL retained. Quotes and generic food/person nouns protect unknown item/name gender. All three-day ceremony and gift limits unchanged.
